metaDescription: Japanese Bobtail vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Japanese Bobtail boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Japanese Bobtail social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Japanese Bobtail exposure.
Weight range 6-10 lb (2.7-4.5 kg) and grooming needs (Coat varies.) belong in the same Japanese Bobtail household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Japanese Bobtail is also monitored for patellar luxation, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Japanese Bobtail appointments.
After the Japanese Bobtail puppy/kitten series, keep adult FVRCP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Japanese Bobtail misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Japanese Bobtail series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Japanese Bobtail is the gap, not the embarrassment, because panleukopenia pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated kitten even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up FVRCP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Japanese Bobtail away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Japanese Bobtail due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Japanese Bobtail core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Japanese Bobtail misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Japanese Bobtail health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Japanese Bobtail adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
